description: Dataset for Dispa-SET UCED hydropower formulations. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alizon Triny Huallpara, Sergio Balderrama (Universidad Mayor de San Simón). This dataset contains the input files for three different hydropower formulations within Dispa-SET mid-term hydrothermal scheduling model. This dataset comprises the data used in the manuscript currently under peer review, titled "Assessing the Operational Impact of Hydropower Over-simplification in National Energy System Models". Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
